name: Hollywood Bl, Highland Av to Vermont Av
source: Path taken from the LA Metro GTFS shape for line 217 (shape 2170355_JUNE26, October 2026 feed).
notes: LADOT's Hollywood Boulevard Safety and Mobility Project covers Hollywood Bl from Gower St to Hillhurst Av / Lyman Pl. Sections Gower St to Western Av and Western Av to Vermont Av are inside the project; Highland Av to Vine St and Vine St to Gower St are west of it and serve as untreated controls. No Metro bus runs on Hollywood Bl between Vermont Av and Hillhurst Av (lines 180 and 217 turn onto Vermont Av), so the corridor stops at Vermont Av and the easternmost 0.3 mi of the project has no bus data. Line 180 joins Hollywood Bl at Vine St, so only line 217 (and Rapid 780 until it was withdrawn around 2020-21) covers Highland Av to Vine St. Vine St to Gower St is about a quarter mile, short for minute-rounded timetables. The event date comes from a LAist report and should be re-checked against LADOT before publication.

description: LADOT's Hollywood Boulevard Safety and Mobility Project added parking-protected bike lanes and other safety improvements on Hollywood Bl between Gower St and Hillhurst Av. Since it was built in 2024, LADOT reports it has reduced average speeds on Hollywood Bl and increased bicycling and walking without significantly increasing congestion.

Phase 2 extends it onto Sunset Bl between Hillhurst Av and Fountain Av, closing a gap for people traveling in Los Feliz and East Hollywood. Protected bike lanes will create a five-mile continuous bike lane from Hollywood to Echo Park. Parking will be fully removed on the southbound side of Sunset Bl and partly removed on the northbound side; all travel lanes remain.

Phase 2 also reconfigures the large Hollywood Bl / Hillhurst Av / Sunset Bl / Virgil Av / Sunset Dr intersection by the Vista Theatre: a relocated and a new crosswalk to shorten crossings, protected left-turn signals from Hillhurst Av and Virgil Av, right turns only in and out of Sunset Dr, and new ADA curb ramps at every corner.
